# What does a lash set really earn per hour?

> Free lash studio pricing calculator: enter price, chair time, supplies, no-shows, card fees and studio rent to see what each lash service takes home per hour, compare full sets and fills, and find the price that reaches your target. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
